expected: One canonical production Firebase project across repository, Vercel, rules, indexes, and release operations.
actual: Repository .firebaserc defaults to torque-empire-crm-prod while runtime evidence points to torque-empire-ai-pro-crm.
impact: Rules and index deployments can be applied to the wrong Firebase project, creating false release confidence.
recommendedAction: Select the canonical production Firebase project and align .firebaserc, Vercel environment variables, Firebase CLI commands, release docs, and operational runbooks.

expected: Runtime Firestore composite indexes match firestore.indexes.json.
actual: Runtime project torque-empire-ai-pro-crm returned zero composite indexes; repository default project torque-empire-crm-prod returned five deals indexes.
impact: Production queries may fail under real traffic even when repository validation passes.
recommendedAction: Deploy firestore.indexes.json to the actual runtime project or switch production runtime configuration to the indexed canonical project.

actual: Runtime Firebase project has failed functions api and onUserCreate.
impact: Failed legacy functions can confuse incident response and may indicate stale or broken production infrastructure.
recommendedAction: Confirm ownership and delete obsolete functions or redeploy required functions with a documented owner.

expected: Firestore delete protection enabled or an approved backup/restore control documented.
impact: Accidental production database deletion risk remains.
recommendedAction: Enable delete protection or formally document compensating backup and restore controls.

expected: Authenticated production E2E evidence for all RC1 roles and workflows.
actual: Login/workflow/screenshots/application IDs/timeline IDs/audit IDs are incomplete.
impact: The platform cannot be certified for client onboarding or RC1 release.
recommendedAction: Run production E2E evidence collection after Firebase drift is resolved.

expected: Firestore, Authentication, and Storage records reconciled.
actual: Document-level export and reconciliation did not complete from this workstation.
impact: Schema drift, orphaned records, and broken storage references may remain undetected.
recommendedAction: Run the Firebase Admin integrity audit from an approved GCP/Firebase execution environment.

expected: Local, development, preview, and production variable names intentionally aligned.
actual: Local environment is missing several Vercel variable names and contains legacy-only email/workstation credential names.
impact: Local reproduction and production validation can diverge.
recommendedAction: Update the environment matrix and .env example without exposing secret values.

expected: No temporary QA users or documents remain after production validation.
actual: Interrupted prior E2E attempts may have created prod-f3c185b-* QA users/documents.
impact: Operational reports and auth surfaces may contain validation records.
recommendedAction: Search for, disable, and document cleanup of temporary QA users and records.
